title: Puntledge RV Park and Campground

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Situated in the picturesque town of Courtenay, BC, Canada, Puntledge RV Park & Campground offers a serene escape for outdoor enthusiasts looking to immerse themselves in nature. Nestled alongside the tranquil waters of the Puntledge River, this First Nations RV Park provides a unique camping experience that combines modern amenities with a touch of indigenous culture. At Puntledge RV Park & Campground, guests can choose from a range of recreational sites to suit their needs, from fully serviced RV sites with 30/50 amp service to basic tent sites for a more rustic camping experience. Puntledge RV Campground is the only campground within walking distance to downtown Courtenay - situated next to the Puntledge River, it is a great family vacation spot with river access for swimming or other recreational activities.
